description: This file contains functions and logic for creating and managing project structures within the FreeCodeCamp curriculum, including prompts for user input, project creation, and updating related JSON files.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Main function to create a new project, update structures, and generate necessary files based on user input.

methods.name: updateIntroJson
methods.description: Updates the intro.json file with the new project's title.

methods.name: createMetaJson
methods.description: Creates or updates the metadata JSON for the project, including help category and challenge info.

methods.name: createFirstChallenge
methods.description: Creates the initial challenge for a project, typically an HTML challenge seed.

methods.name: createQuizChallenge
methods.description: Creates a quiz challenge with specified question count.

methods.name: getChapters
methods.description: Retrieves chapter information for a given superBlock.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves module information for a specific chapter within a superBlock.
